description: AX Notes voice triggers. Phrases are plain words with at most one {slot}; {slot?} may be empty. Same set as NoteTriggers.DEFAULTS. Moves to triggers@1 (lib-triggers) when that lands.

triggers.label: Take a note
triggers.description: Starts dictation; everything you say goes into the note until “end note”.

triggers.label: End note
triggers.description: Ends dictation and saves the note.

triggers.label: Cancel note
triggers.description: Throws away the note being dictated.

triggers.label: Quick note
triggers.description: Saves the words after “note” as a note right away.

triggers.label: Read back
triggers.description: Reads notes aloud: “read back last”, “read back today” or a category name.

triggers.label: Summarize
triggers.description: Summarizes a category (or all notes) aloud.

triggers.label: Open notes
triggers.description: Opens AX Notes on the notes screen.

triggers.label: Add to-do
triggers.description: Adds an item; end with “to <list>” to pick the list.

triggers.label: Check off
triggers.description: Ticks the item whose words match best.

triggers.label: New list
triggers.description: Creates a list (“new todo list …” makes a to-do list).
